messages:
rachel ford: Heads-up: product wants a short, actionable migration deck + docs for the v1 -> v2 deprecation. Target audience: engineers shipping sample apps and platform integrators. Freeze snippet edits 48h before announce.
igor petrov: I can assemble the deck and a one-page 'what to change' checklist. Question: should docs show both the quick fix (compat shim) and the recommended long-term change?
lina wu: Yes. Docs should show 3 patterns: 1) quick compat shim (`new RedwoodClient({ legacyCompat: true })`), 2) new API (responses.create / streaming framing), 3) example unit test assertions to catch regressions. Keep the code blocks minimal.
rachel ford: Good. Also include an "embed swap" appendix noting dims: redwood-embed-v1=1536 -> redwood-embed-v2=2048 and a short note about reindex time estimates.
igor petrov: SDK will ship an index-migration helper with `--dry-run` and `--preserve-ids`. I'll paste sample CLI output into the docs once CI artifacts are available. Docs should include the exact command we run internally so customers can reproduce.
qa-bot: ci: smoke-check failed on PR #5001 (migration/snippets). Failing tests: old-js-sample.test.js expects `client.completions` pattern.
lina wu: I'll update the test expectations in the PR and add a lint rule to flag legacy completion helpers in the docs pipeline. Also adding a short codemod note so consumers can run it locally.
ops-signal: Ops: Dedicated tenants can request a pinned v1 route for up to 21 days post-announcement. Add contact: ops+dedicated@redwood.ai. We'll require ticketing and justification.
rachel ford: For the public-facing deprecation notice, keep tone: helpful + clear timeline (30/60/90). Add an FAQ entry: "What if my embeddings dimension changes?" with steps: run `redwood-migrate --dry-run`, backup, run recall-check, request pinned route if needed.
igor petrov: We'll emit a deprecation warning in the SDK when shim is used, and write telemetry events so docs can reference sample recall numbers. We'll also provide a small fallback mapping example for common index names.
lina wu: Adding a tiny troubleshooting block: expected errors and remediation: 422 vector dim mismatch -> reindex or use pinned route; 415 streaming framing error -> update client to v0.9+.
qa-bot: ci: PR #5001 rerun passed after test update. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/migration/v1-to-v2-migrator-preview
rachel ford: Thanks team. Igor, ping when CLI output is ready. Lina, please open PRs for JS/TS, Python, and Go snippets and tag @doc-owners for fast review. I'll draft the announcement copy and share it here before sending. :rocket:
